context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 71 fixed a critical React Hooks violation in RunnerTokens.js. The compact mode now correctly displays Analyze, Buy, and DEX link buttons. Wallet connection is required to see Runner Tokens in the UI. The fix moved useState hooks from inside the if(compact) block to the top level of the component.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: useState hooks were placed inside the if(compact) conditional block at lines 141-143, violating React's Rules of Hooks which require hooks to be called at the top level of the component in the same order on every render
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Moved the three useState hooks (buyInputOpen, buyAmount, buying) to the top level of the component alongside other state declarations
rca_of_the_issue.verification: ESLint passes, page loads without compilation errors, code review confirms all features are properly implemented
